title: Compatible injective resolutions of boundary-cycle-homology rows
statement: Let $B$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with enough injectives [def-sp-enough-injectives], and $K$ an integer-indexed cochain complex with $K^p=0$ for $p<0$. There exist injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions] $I_Z^p,I_D^p,I_H^p$ of $Z^p(K),\operatorname{im}(d^{p-1}),H^p(K)$ respectively and maps $w^p:I_D^p\to I_Z^p$, $x^p:I_Z^p\to I_H^p$. Each row $0\to I_D^p\to I_Z^p\to I_H^p\to0$ is short exact, and both squares with the original boundary-to-cycle inclusion [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-boundary-projection] and homology projection commute after applying the single-degree-zero functor. Moreover $I_Z^p=0$ for $p<0$ and $I_D^p=0$ for $p\le0$. This statement makes no choice of resolutions of $K^p$ or of cycle-term-boundary rows.

source.place: Lemma 015I, proof Steps 1--4; prescribed-end horseshoe Lemma 013T

proof.text: The boundary inclusion is mono because its composite with the cycle inclusion is image.ι. The projection to homology is epi. Comparing the boundary-cycle-homology short complex with toCycles followed by homologyπ, using the epi factorThruImage, transfers exactness from the defining cokernel of homology. This proves the source row is short exact.

For p<=0, the boundary object is zero since the source K^(p-1) of its epi image factor is zero. For p<0, homology is zero since K^p is zero. Use InjectiveResolution.self for these zero objects, whose injectivity follows from IsZero.injective; elsewhere use InjectiveResolution.of. The single-degree-zero functor carries a zero object to a zero complex.

Apply the prescribed-end horseshoe theorem to the source row independently for each p, with the chosen boundary and homology resolutions. Choose the resulting middle resolution and maps. The theorem gives both augmentation squares and degreewise short exactness; shortExact_of_degreewise_shortExact gives a short exact row of complexes. When p<0 its two end complexes are zero. The inclusion of the boundary resolution is then an isomorphism, so the middle cycle resolution is zero.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_cartanEilenberg_object_resolution_rows
    (B : Type u) [Category.{v} B] [Abelian B] [EnoughInjectives B]
    (K : CochainComplex B ℤ) (hK : ∀ p : ℤ, p < 0 → IsZero (K.X p)) :
    ∃ (IZ : ∀ p, InjectiveResolution (K.cycles p))
      (ID : ∀ p, InjectiveResolution (image (K.d (p - 1) p)))
      (IH : ∀ p, InjectiveResolution (K.homology p))
      (w : ∀ p, (ID p).cocomplex ⟶ (IZ p).cocomplex)
      (x : ∀ p, (IZ p).cocomplex ⟶ (IH p).cocomplex),
      (∀ p, p < 0 → IsZero (IZ p).cocomplex) ∧
      (∀ p, p ≤ 0 → IsZero (ID p).cocomplex) ∧
      (∃ hwx : ∀ p, w p ≫ x p = 0,
        ∀ p, (ShortComplex.mk (w p) (x p) (hwx p)).ShortExact) ∧
      (∀ p, (CochainComplex.single₀ B).map (cartanEilenbergBoundaryInclusion K p) ≫
        (IZ p).ι = (ID p).ι ≫ w p) ∧
      (∀ p, (CochainComplex.single₀ B).map (K.homologyπ p) ≫ (IH p).ι =
        (IZ p).ι ≫ x p)
